title: Reconnaissance Grammar
reward: Learn reconnaissance as behavior grammar, not a blacklist of paths.
knowledge: Combine breadth, target sensitivity, sequence, cadence and response outcomes.
Differentiate generic crawler discovery from focused secret/admin/framework probing.
A single sensitive path is weak evidence; repeated diverse sensitive targets are stronger.
Scan evidence describes discovery behavior, not compromise.
Legitimate tools can scan; intent remains a hypothesis.
challenge: Build a recon hypothesis from multiple independent features.
Provide a benign alternative and what evidence would separate them.
